stem: An order of €100 had three touches. The linear report shows €33.33 for each touch, €99.99 in total. What went wrong, and what is the fix?

options.text: Each share was rounded before adding up; round only the final totals
Nothing went wrong, since linear credit never adds up to the order's revenue
One touch was lost from the path, so each share should be €25.00
The missing cent belongs on the report's unattributed row instead
